line: Crowley's Atu VII: Cancer, the cardinal sign of Water, and the path from Binah to Geburah; its letter appears in a footnote, not an attribution sentence.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The sign Cancer, the element Water, and the letter Cheth, which the text gives only in a footnote on the number 418. The table is the source for Cheth's attribution as the letter.

quotes.quote: Atu VII refers to the zodiacal sign of Cancer, the sign into which the Sun moves at the Summer Solstice.
Cancer is the cardinal sign of the element of Water,
Note that Cheth—Cheth 8—Yod 10—Tan 400—has the value of 418.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree, and the card figure
sections.line: Cancer is the path from Binah to Geburah. The Key Scale numbers it 18. Crowley says the figure has one function, which is to bear the Holy Grail.

quotes.quote: Cancer also represents the path which leads from the great Mother Binah to Geburah
His only function is to bear the Holy Grail.
